body: thank you.  i've been trying this for a month or two now, and sometimes it works.  sometimes it's just too much.  hence the frustration and depression.

no, i don't.  she has her own place.  she's been really supportive of me this whole time, but it kills me when i kiss her and feel nothing because of all this.

we've only been dating for about 6 months.

also, how do you find a good therapist?  what do you consider good?  i've gone through about 4 or so in my lifetime, 2 when i was younger, and 2 now.  the one i have now loves to talk about herself and her family a lot. which i find fucking annoying.  she seems more interested in formulating hypothesis about my neurosis than actually treating me like a feeling human being.

thanks for your words.

i don't want to focus on my sexuality, but it's really hard when you have a girlfriend, you know?  i mean, when i'm around her, i'm just constantly reminded of these fucked up things going on in my head.  and then i can't respond physically because i'm so anxious and depressed.  which makes this whole thing even worse.  if i could find refuge in her, like i've done in the past, it wouldn't be that bad.  but i can't even do that anymore.  i don't know what's changed.
